fields.statement: QA with a fresh build (go build -trimpath to a scratch path): rhiza guide conduct-roles prints the topic (708 tokens, listed by guide ls); rhiza guide conduct's Read first names conduct-roles; all ten roles it lists (builder..conflict-fix) resolve with rhiza guide <role>; its spawn flags match rhiza run spawn --help; the refusal text 'name one of its checks' is in internal/api/run_spawn.go; ship-change declares plan, code, qa; go test ./internal/guide (TestConductRoles*, TestConduct, TestList), ./internal/api -run TestRunSpawnCheck and ./cmd/rhiza TestScripts/guide pass

QA with a fresh build: rhiza guide conduct-handback prints the topic (629 tokens), named in conduct's Read first; its handback.md parts match internal/run/brief.go's headings; its routes (gate, signoff, push, wait-ci, merge) are exactly ship-change's handback:conduct steps and its four gate commands match the gate step; rhiza ship rebase --no-push exists per its --help; handback_cap 3 matches ship-change; TestConductHandback* and TestScripts/guide pass

QA with a fresh build in a scratch repo: rhiza guide workflow-keys prints the topic (910 tokens), named by conduct and workflows (which lists gate); rhiza workflow new demo writes start=build, agent step build, command step test with a failing placeholder, max_visits=3, on.fail=handback:build as the topic says; a second new demo is refused (exit 3, file left); new --from ship-change copies with name set; --from nosuch fails cleanly (exit 2); workflow check demo validates with the placeholder warning; TestWorkflowKeys*, TestWorkflowsText and TestScripts/guide pass
